title: Motor Attention Training for Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)
official: A Feasibility/Pilot Trial of a Motor Attention Training Intervention for College Students With ADHD
summary: The investigators will perform a feasibility/pilot trial of two non-pharmacological interventions for ADHD in college students.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* University of Wisconsin-Madison enrolled undergraduate
* Documented ADHD diagnosis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable or unwilling to participate in the interventions
